content.title: Yukon Streetscape
content.summary: The Yukon Streetscape Project, initiated as part of the Olde Town Arvada Strategic and Reinvestment Plan adopted in October 2023, aims to enhance walkability and public spaces in Olde Town while preserving its historic charm. Scheduled for construction to begin in summer 2026, the project will feature wider sidewalks, redesigned intersections for improved safety, changes to parking configurations, and new streetscape amenities. The Arvada Urban Renewal Authority is leading the project, with ongoing community engagement to refine plans based on public feedback.
content.body:
## Project background

The Yukon Streetscape Project is a key early step in implementing the [Olde Town Arvada Strategic and Reinvestment Plan](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68cd97673560a), which was adopted by Arvada City Council in October 2023. This long-term vision aims to preserve Olde Town’s historic charm while enhancing public spaces and improving walkability throughout the downtown core.

Yukon Street has been identified as the first opportunity to bring the plan to life — starting with upgraded sidewalks, safer crossings, and a more comfortable pedestrian environment.

The project is led by the [Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA)](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/) with support from the City of Arvada.

[![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6336)](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/)

## Timeline

- Spring 2026: Project goes to bid (one month)
- Summer 2026: Construction begins
- Winter 2026: Construction anticipated to be completed

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6335)

## Key improvements

### Wider sidewalks for walkability

Once complete, the project will create wider sidewalks for walkability and public space at the following locations:

- East side of Yukon Street (between Grandview Ave. and Ralston Rd.)
- North side of Grandview Ave (between Yukon St and Olde Wadsworth Blvd.)

Sidewalks will be constructed with concrete and decorative clay brick pavers, designed to match the existing Olde Town aesthetic.

### Intersections are being redesigned to improve safety

- **57th Avenue and Yukon Stree****t**: The old traffic circle was removed and replaced with a 4-way stop and bulb-outs on all four corners to slow vehicle speeds and shorten pedestrian crossing distances.
- **Grandview Avenue and Yukon Street**: Bulb-outs will be added to the northern corners of the intersection to improve visibility and pedestrian safety.

       

### Parking configuration changes

Along Yukon Street, the current head-in parking will be converted to parallel parking, improving traffic flow and making space for the new sidewalk design.

Along Grandview Avenue, five parking spaces will be removed from the north side — two in front of 7609 Grandview Ave. and three in front of 7603 Grandview Ave. — to allow sidewalk widening consistent with the existing bulb-outs at Yukon and Olde Wadsworth Blvd.

### Streetscape amenities

As space allows, the Yukon Streetscape's new pedestrian-friendly features will include:

- Trees
- Streetscape-appropriate planting
- Trash and recycling bins
- Bike racks
- Pedestrian-scale lighting

## What to expect during construction

Construction is anticipated to begin in 2025 and take approximately three to five months to complete. During this time, the public may experience:

- Temporary single-lane closures
- Modified business access
- Increased construction noise and traffic
- A designated construction staging area (to be determined)

The City will work to minimize disruption and maintain clear communication with businesses and residents throughout the project.

### Community engagement

A public meeting was held in November 2024 to introduce the project and gather feedback from the community. Input from that meeting continues to guide project refinements.
